parameters.help_en: The number of records to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud order ID. This can be a virtual order ID
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云订单 ID（含虚拟订单 ID）
parameters.name: aliyun_order_id

parameters.help_en: The purchase channel. Valid values: \`aliyun\_market\` (Alibaba Cloud Marketplace) and \`aliyun\_public\` (standard purchase page)
parameters.help_zh: 购买渠道：可选项 aliyun_market（云市场）/aliyun_public（普通购买页）
parameters.name: purchase_channel

parameters.help_en:
The package type. Valid values:

- single\_node\_subscribe: single node (subscription)

- single\_node\_long\_term: single node (long-term)

- primary\_backup\_subscribe: primary/standby (subscription)

- primary\_backup\_long\_term: primary/standby (long-term)

- pre\_generation\_long\_term: pre-generated (long-term)
parameters.help_zh:
套餐类型，可选项：
- single_node_subscribe，单节点（订阅）
- single_node_long_term，单节点（长期）
- primary_backup_subscribe，主备版（订阅）
- primary_backup_long_term，主备版（长期）
- pre_generation_long_term，预生成（长期）
parameters.name: package_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query only virtual orders
parameters.name: virtual_order
